estimates: The native envelopes and published engineering facts establish the tower, podium and street clearance. Glazing rhythm, plaza features, interior structure visible through the glass, roof landscaping and detailed cladding are estimated.
The model adopts the mapped 245.8 metre architectural height for the tower. Some design descriptions give a nominal 254 metres. Public sources differ in measurement conventions.
The original elevation is preserved. Adjacent skyscrapers, metro works, corporate trademarks and the historic exchange site in Luohu are outside scope.

review.notes: The Qualla article’s public-domain image depicts 1990s trading before the tower was constructed. Its CC0 skyline cannot establish the building’s details. The Commons category includes the same historic image and one company logo as its only public-domain records. Current mapped geometry and the architect’s and engineer’s written facts support the exterior.
